enrich.rationale: Residual-driven active learning will preferentially add new solves where the current winner’s residuals are largest/most uncertain, improving coverage along the correlated inputs and reducing RMSE faster than another tuning-only search.

diagnosis: The bottleneck is sample coverage in specific input directions (r0/a/kappa/delta/Ip) with stable generalization estimates, so error is dominated by structured residuals rather than tuning noise.
